summary: Opened and queued one more consequence of the configuration gap, this time on the participant-eligibility path: a focused probe that restarts a node from the snapshot's three-voter configuration while five voters are in force, then sends it two vote requests that are identical except for candidate identity — one from a voter the configuration in force contains but its recovered set does not, one from a voter inside the recovered set — both flagged as leadership transfers so the leader-availability rule cannot decide either. The event emits both results, the recovered and in-force voter sets, and each candidate's membership, with a setup event carrying the premise; the comparison asserts the stale set does not reject a member of the configuration in force. Locally the probe passes, but its receipt is unread, so no account has been recorded for this question yet.
